title: Shared Intelligence Consolidation
scope: Consolidate Discovery Scanner and Opportunity Radar onto one neutral canonical Alpaca U.S.-equity universe owner only where the G0-G3 source audit proved duplicate acquisition/cache ownership.
Preserve the existing 12-hour universe TTL and provider-backed timestamp truth.
Coalesce concurrent Scanner/Radar universe misses so one refresh satisfies both consumers.
On failed refresh, preserve the last provider-backed timestamp instead of making stale evidence appear fresh.
Use bounded five-minute retry suppression and an explicitly identifiable deterministic seed fallback when no provider-backed cache exists.
Preserve Scanner ranking and Opportunity Radar sampling/promotion semantics.

Preserve Smart Provider Router v2, BroadSnapshotBroker, Session Intelligence, Event Intelligence, Research evidence hydration, deterministic Day/Swing/Long market truth, GLD/SLV/USO tradable exceptions and the permanent No Execution Boundary.
Repair release identity/scaffolding so the already-qualified v18.8 product source publishes as v18.8.0 without touching immutable v18.7.0 Stable.
outOfScope: No new provider or external service.
No parallel provider router, snapshot broker, universe owner, freshness engine, reliability engine or decision engine.
No broad Scanner ranking or Radar promotion redesign.
No execution, paper trading, order routing, P&L, portfolio or journal features.
No broad renderer redesign or unrelated UI modularization.
No modification, movement or overwrite of the existing v18.7.0-stable tag.
permanentBoundaries: Smart Provider Router v2 is sole provider-routing authority
BroadSnapshotBroker remains canonical snapshot reuse/coalescing owner
Deterministic Day/Swing/Long market truth remains protected
